6.370 rsConflictingNaturalSortRequirements
Applies to RDL 2011/01
rsConflictingNaturalSortRequirements is a critical error that occurs when two or more groupings
associated with a DataSet describe conflicting NaturalSort requirements. A grouping without an
ancestor/descendent relationship associated with the same dataset can use NaturalSort only if they
define the same sequence of SortExpression.
